{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=True).astype(float)

# Remove QA orders: revenue == 999999.99
qa_orders = data[data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
data_clean = data[(data['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) & (data['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute conversion rate by channel
grouped = data_clean.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
conversion_rate_email = grouped['email']
conversion_rate_paid_search = grouped['paid_search']
conversion_diff = conversion_rate_email - conversion_rate_paid_search

# Compute average revenue by channel
avg_revenue_email = data_clean[data_clean['channel'] == 'email']['revenue_clean'].mean()
avg_revenue_paid_search = data_clean[data_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search']['revenue_clean'].mean()
revenue_diff = avg_revenue_email - avg_revenue_paid_search

# Compute conversion rate and revenue by channel and customer_segment
segment_grouped = data_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])[['converted', 'revenue_clean']].mean()

# Extract specific values for evidence
# Email conversion rates by segment
email_loyal_conv = segment_grouped.loc[('email', 'loyal'), 'converted']
email_returning_conv = segment_grouped.loc[('email', 'returning'), 'converted']
email_new_conv = segment_grouped.loc[('email', 'new'), 'converted']

# Paid search conversion rates by segment
paid_search_loyal_conv = segment_grouped.loc[('paid_search', 'loyal'), 'converted']
paid_search_returning_conv = segment_grouped.loc[('paid_search', 'returning'), 'converted']
paid_search_new_conv = segment_grouped.loc[('paid_search', 'new'), 'converted']

# Email revenue by segment
email_loyal_rev = segment_grouped.loc[('email', 'loyal'), 'revenue_clean']
email_returning_rev = segment_grouped.loc[('email', 'returning'), 'revenue_clean']
email_new_rev = segment_grouped.loc[('email', 'new'), 'revenue_clean']

# Paid search revenue by segment
paid_search_loyal_rev = segment_grouped.loc[('paid_search', 'loyal'), 'revenue_clean']
paid_search_returning_rev = segment_grouped.loc[('paid_search', 'returning'), 'revenue_clean']
paid_search_new_rev = segment_grouped.loc[('paid_search', 'new'), 'revenue_clean']

# Print all required values
print(f"Email channel conversion rate: {conversion_rate_email:.4f}")
print(f"Paid search channel conversion rate: {conversion_rate_paid_search:.4f}")
print(f"Conversion rate difference (email - paid_search): {conversion_diff:.4f}")

print(f"Email channel average revenue: {avg_revenue_email:.2f}")
print(f"Paid search channel average revenue: {avg_revenue_paid_search:.2f}")
print(f"Average revenue difference (email - paid_search): {revenue_diff:.2f}")

# Print segment-level conversion rates
print(f"Email loyal conversion: {email_loyal_conv:.4f}")
print(f"Email returning conversion: {email_returning_conv:.4f}")
print(f"Email new conversion: {email_new_conv:.4f}")

print(f"Paid search loyal conversion: {paid_search_loyal_conv:.4f}")
print(f"Paid search returning conversion: {paid_search_returning_conv:.4f}")
print(f"Paid search new conversion: {paid_search_new_conv:.4f}")

# Print segment-level revenue
print(f"Email loyal revenue: {email_loyal_rev:.2f}")
print(f"Email returning revenue: {email_returning_rev:.2f}")
print(f"Email new revenue: {email_new_rev:.2f}")

print(f"Paid search loyal revenue: {paid_search_loyal_rev:.2f}")
print(f"Paid search returning revenue: {paid_search_returning_rev:.2f}")
print(f"Paid search new revenue: {paid_search_new_rev:.2f}")"}
